question.text: As per the Investment Adviser compliance framework described in Chapter 19.7 of the NISM Series X-A workbook (June 2025), the annual compliance audit of an Investment Adviser is to be conducted by:

answer.text: An internal compliance officer of the IA firm
A practising Chartered Accountant (as specified in Chapter 19.7, p.374)

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook's Chapter 19.7 (p.374) specifies that the annual compliance audit of an Investment Adviser must be conducted by a practising Chartered Accountant, with any material observations to be disclosed. The stem now points specifically to that chapter so this version is uniquely correct. The Trap: An internal compliance officer handles ongoing compliance but cannot act as the external auditor; SEBI may inspect but does not perform the IA's annual compliance audit; AMFI-empanelled auditors relate to mutual fund distribution audit, not IA compliance audit. The audit flagged the original because p.349 of the same workbook also permits the yearly audit to be conducted by an eligible member of ICAI/ICSI/ICMAI, so the unqualified "CA-only must" stem was over-narrow. Note: The original was ambiguous because the workbook is internally inconsistent on audit-eligibility wording across pp.349 and 374 (NISM Series X-A, June 2025). The stem has been qualified to Chapter 19.7 (p.374), the source that specifically states "practising Chartered Accountant", which uniquely supports the keyed option.
